item.title: Asking Strangers in Tokyo About Their Biggest Dating Red Flags
item.description: Tokyo Sims asks strangers an unexpected dating question: what's a red flag they secretly find attractive? From questionable preferences to surprising confessions, people reveal the traits they know they should avoid but can't help being drawn to.

item.title: Who Has It Harder in Life: Men or Women?
item.description: Tokyo Sims asks strangers a thought-provoking question: who has a harder life, men or women? From societal expectations to everyday struggles, people share their perspectives on the different challenges each gender faces.
